More In News Working Families Tax Cuts News releases Tax relief in disaster situations Around the nation Topics in the news Fact sheets IRS statements and announcements IRS Tax Tips IRS guidance Multimedia center Tax articles to share Posters to share IRS announces tax relief for Hurricane Zeta victims AL-2020-03, December 11, 2020 — Victims of Hurricane Zeta that began October 28, 2020 now have until March 1, 2021, to file various individual and business tax returns and make tax payments, the Internal Revenue Service announced today. IRS announces tax relief for Puerto Rico severe storm and flooding victims PR-2020-03, December 8, 2020 — Victims of a severe storm and flooding on September 13, have until January 15, 2021, to file various individual and business tax returns and make tax payments, the Internal Revenue Service announced today. IRS announces more parishes eligible for tax relief for victims of Hurricanes Delta and Laura LA-2020-06, November 25, 2020 — The Internal Revenue Service announced today that victims of Hurricane Delta in 64 parishes are now eligible for tax relief. More parishes were recently added to those eligible for tax relief after Hurricane Laura. IRS announces tax relief for Hurricane Delta victims LA-2020-05, October 20, 2020 — Victims of Hurricane Delta that began October 6 now have until February 16, 2021, to file various individual and business tax returns and make tax payments, the IRS announced today. IRS announces tax relief for September California wildfire victims CA-2020-07, October 19, 2020 — Victims of the California wildfires that began on September 4 may qualify for tax relief from the IRS. IRS provides tax relief for victims of September wildfires in California; Oct. 15 deadline, other dates extended to Jan. 15 IR-2020-237, October 19, 2020 — Victims of the California wildfires that began on September 4 now have until January 15, 2021, to file various individual and business tax returns and make tax payments, the Internal Revenue Service announced today. IRS provides tax relief for victims of Hurricane Delta; Oct. 15 deadline, other dates extended to Feb. 16 IR-2020-236, October 19, 2020 — Victims of Hurricane Delta that began on October 6 now have until February 16, 2021 to file various individual and business tax returns and make tax payments, the Internal Revenue Service announced today. IRS announces tax relief for Hurricane Sally victims in Florida FL-2020-03, October 5, 2020 — Victims of Hurricane Sally that began September 14, 2020 now have until January 15, 2021, to file various individual and business tax returns and make tax payments, the Internal Revenue Service announced today. IRS provides tax relief for victims of Hurricane Sally; Oct. 15 deadline, other dates extended to Jan. 15 IR-2020-222, September 24, 2020 — Victims of Hurricane Sally that began on September 14 now have until January 15, 2021 to file various individual and business tax returns and make tax payments, the Internal Revenue Service announced today. IRS announces tax relief for Hurricane Sally victims AL-2020-02, September 21, 2020 — Victims of Hurricane Sally that took place on Sept. 14 now have until Jan. 15, 2021, to file various individual and business tax returns and make tax payments, the IRS announced today. IRS provides tax relief for victims of Oregon wildfires; Oct. 15 deadline, other dates extended to Jan. 15 IR-2020-215, September 17, 2020 — Victims of the Oregon wildfires and straight-line winds that began on September 7 now have until January 15, 2021 to file various individual and business tax returns and make tax payments, the Internal Revenue Service announced today. IRS announces tax relief for Tropical Storm Isaias victims in Puerto Rico PR-2020-02, September 10, 2020 — Victims of Tropical Storm Isaias that began July 29, now have until Nov. 30, 2020, to file various individual and business tax returns and make tax payments, the IRS announced today. IRS announces tax relief for Hurricane Laura victims LA-2020-03, September 1, 2020 — Victims of Hurricane Laura that began Aug. 22 now have until Dec. 31, 2020, to file various individual and business tax returns and make tax payments, the IRS announced today. IRS provides tax relief for victims of Hurricane Laura; Oct. 15 deadline, other dates extended to Dec. 31 IR-2020-197, August 31, 2020 — Victims of Hurricane Laura that began August 22 now have until December 31, 2020, to file various individual and business tax returns and make tax payments, the IRS announced today. IRS announces tax relief for California wildfire victims CA-2020-06, August 26, 2020 — Victims of the California wildfires that began on August 14 may qualify for tax relief from the IRS. IRS announces tax relief for Iowa derecho victims IA-2020-05, August 26, 2020 — Victims of the August 10 derecho in Iowa may qualify for tax relief from the IRS. IRS provides tax relief for victims of Iowa derecho; extends Oct. 15, other upcoming deadlines to Dec. 15 IR-2020-190, August 24, 2020 — Victims of the August 10 derecho storm that affected parts of Iowa now have until December 15, 2020, to file various individual and business tax returns and make tax payments, the IRS announced today. IRS provides tax relief for victims of California wildfires; Oct. 15 deadline, other dates extended to Dec. 15 IR-2020-191, August 24, 2020 — Victims of the California wildfires that began August 14 now have until December 15, 2020 to file various individual and business tax returns and make tax payments, the IRS announced today. IRS announces tax relief for Utah earthquake victims UT-2020-01, July 24, 2020 — Victims of the earthquake and aftershocks that began on March 18, 2020 in Utah may qualify for tax relief from the IRS. IRS announces tax relief for Michigan severe storm victims MI-2020-01, July 24, 2020 — Victims of the severe storms and flooding that began on May 16, 2020 in Michigan may qualify for tax relief from the IRS. IRS announces tax relief for South Carolina victims of severe storms, tornadoes and straight-line winds SC-2020-01, June 30, 2020 — Victims of the severe storms, tornadoes and straight-line winds that began on April 12, 2020 in South Carolina may qualify for tax relief from the IRS. IRS announces tax relief for Tennessee victims of severe storms, tornadoes, straight-line winds and flooding TN-2020-02, June 30, 2020 — Victims of the tornadoes, severe storms, flooding and straight-line winds that began on April 12, 2020 in Tennessee may qualify for tax relief from the Internal Revenue Service. IRS announces tax relief for Mississippi victims of tornadoes, severe storms, flooding and straight-line winds MS-2020-01, June 29, 2020 — Victims of the tornadoes, severe storms, flooding and straight-line winds that began on April 12, 2020 in Mississippi may qualify for tax relief from the IRS. IRS extends July 15, other upcoming deadlines for tornado victims in parts of the South; provides other relief IR-2020-126, June 23, 2020 — Victims of the April tornadoes, severe storms and flooding that took place in parts of Mississippi, Tennessee and South Carolina will have until October 15, 2020, to file various individual and business tax returns and make tax payments, the Internal Revenue Service announced today. IRS announces tax relief for Oregon victims of severe storms, flooding, landslides and mudslides OR-2020-01, May 5, 2020 — Victims of the severe storms, flooding, landslides and mudslides that began on Feb. 5, 2020, in Oregon may qualify for tax relief from the IRS. IRS announces tax relief for Tennessee victims of severe storms, tornadoes and flooding TN-2020-01, March 6, 2020 — Victims of the severe storms, tornadoes straight-line winds, and flooding that began on March 3, 2020 in Tennessee may qualify for tax relief from the IRS. IRS extends April 15 and other upcoming deadlines, provides other tax relief for victims of Tennessee tornadoes IR-2020-51, March 6, 2020 — Victims of this week’s tornadoes and severe storms in parts of Tennessee, including Nashville, will have until July 15, 2020, to file various individual and business tax returns and make tax payments, the IRS announced today. IRS announces tax relief for victims of earthquakes in Puerto Rico PR-2020-01, January 17, 2020 — Victims of earthquakes that took place beginning on December 28, 2019 in parts of the Commonwealth of Puerto Rico may qualify for tax relief from the IRS. Around the nation Get IRS news in your local area, particularly state-specific information about disaster relief and tax provisions. This page is designated as historical and is no longer updated.
